card.name: Numbers after duration or amount phrases
card.fires_on: The space, 'than' or 'to' just before a number in phrases about how long something lasts or how many are affected, mostly in diarrhea and infection text. It also fires on the first digit of such numbers.

modes.label: Duration before number
modes.description: The slot just before a time figure after 'lasts', 'within' or 'beyond'.
modes.example: Clinical improvement of acute diarrhea is usually observed within<< >>48 hours.

modes.label: Range or comparison linker
modes.description: 'than' or 'to' that leads into a number in a range or a 'more than' phrase.
modes.example: The incubation period generally lasts anywhere from 10 hours<< to>> six days.

modes.label: Dose amount slot
modes.description: The space before a dose amount in a single-dose statement.
